name: Tree View
summary: Tree view component for shadcn/ui that expands, collapses, selects and drags nested items in hierarchical data.
description: A copy-paste tree view component for shadcn/ui that navigates hierarchical lists with nested levels you can expand, collapse and select. It supports custom icons per item (default, open, selected), default node and leaf icons, action buttons, click handlers per item and for the whole tree, drag & drop, a disabled state and custom item renderers. Based on the implementations by WangLarry and bytechase; demo at mrlightful.com/ui/tree-view. MIT licensed.
contains: expand, collapse and select items in nested levels
custom icons per item (default, open, selected) and default node/leaf icons
action buttons, click handlers per item and per tree view
drag & drop support; disabled state; custom item renderers
based on implementations by WangLarry and bytechase
demo at mrlightful.com/ui/tree-view; roadmap adds programmatic control
